rotation: Given the high severity of persistent inflation and geopolitical risks, sectors like energy and materials are likely to remain favored. Conversely, sectors sensitive to interest rate hikes, such as real estate and financials, are pressured. AI and tech sectors may benefit from the investment boom, while labor market dynamics suggest continued pressure on consumer discretionary and healthcare sectors due to stagnant opportunities.
